description: List user's garments with structured filters or query for hybrid name/SKU/metadata/image-attribute search. body_zone expands to categories and is ORed with category when both are given. With a category or body_zone filter and include_uncategorized=false, uncategorized_count reports garments hidden by the category filter within the same scope. If matches are short and uncategorized_count > 0, call again with include_uncategorized=true and inspect those garments.

body_zone.description: Filter to categories in any of these body zones; OR with category when both are given.

category.description: Filter to garments in any of these canonical categories; OR with body_zone when both are given.

end_date.description: Filter: created on or before this date (ISO format)

exclude_clothing_item_ids.description: Exclude these garment IDs, for example the attached garment.

include_image_url.description: Set true when the garment image itself is needed for visual display or reuse.

include_uncategorized.description: Also include garments with no category when category and/or body_zone filters are used. If the first result has uncategorized_count > 0 and too few matches, call again with true and inspect those garments.

query.description: Hybrid search across garment names, SKUs, metadata, and visual attributes.

start_date.description: Filter: created on or after this date (ISO format, e.g. '2025-06-01')

tag_ids.description: Filter to garments with any of these tags

name: list_garments
title: List Garments
